'''Hura Kogler''' was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|daughter]] of the legendary [[Hyndis Kogler]]. Hura joined [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]], and led an operation to place infiltration [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]]. Posing as the [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] '''Shyndi Oglerk''', she sold the droids to a team of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] operatives, who delivered them to the [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Alliance Intelligence]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] ''[[Shadow Raptor]]''. The operatives thwarted the [[Shadow Raptor revolt|subsequent revolt]] and tracked their origin to [[Teagan]]. The operatives cornered Kogler and her team, capturing the agent after first mate [[Kog]] betrayed her and fled. She then tried to threaten the operatives with her father's reputation.
